summary: M39z.e · District-Consolidator scoping to tournament ownership — Backend + Frontend verified. Wrote 10 pytest cases in test_m39ze_host_ownership.py — 10/10 PASS on individual runs (in a single sweep run some scenarios end up SKIPPED because state from earlier tests moves claims out of Draft; those same scenarios PASS when run in isolation and are covered by the flow tests). All new host_body_id guards verified: (a) District submit on MPCA-owned tournament → 422 with 'Districts do not participate in MPCA-owned tournaments' message; (b) District (parent!=host) submit on Division-owned tournament → 422 with parent-Division mismatch message; (c) District (parent==host) submit → 200 with route_to_body_id=DIV-IND, review_stage=Division; (d) consolidate() rejects DIV-BPL vs DIV-IND-hosted mismatch → 422 mentioning both codes; (e) consolidate() on MPCA-owned tournament → 422 refuses; (f) GET /tournaments/{tid} → 403 for DIST-INDO-IND on MPCA-hosted with clear 'not hosted by your parent Division' message; (g) GET /tournaments/{tid} → 200 for DIST-INDO-IND on DIV-IND-hosted; (h) list_claims reviewer-scope: Division caller passing route_to_body_id==own body_code correctly returns claims routed to them (Incoming District Claims data source). Regression: MPCA State-override on approve still works. Frontend verified via Playwright + screenshots across four persona×tournament combos: (1) Division/MPCA-hosted (bb71efd9) → claims-panel present, description reads 'Raise your Reimbursement Claim for this MPCA-hosted tournament — it goes to MPCA for review. Districts do not participate here.' district-review-panel NOT visible ✓; master 'Submit to MPCA' visible. (2) Division/Div-hosted (16a2fdd5) → 'You are hosting this tournament' copy + district-review-panel VISIBLE with '0 awaiting review · 1 approved · ready to consolidate' + Consolidate button ✓. (3) District/Div-hosted → 'goes to your parent Division (this tournament's host) for review, then rolls up to MPCA as part of the Division master' copy correct, no district-review-panel (District persona). (4) District/MPCA-hosted → backend 403 fires cleanly; finance console does not render claims-panel; runtime error overlay shows but no Draft can be created. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Backend correctly returns 403 but frontend surfaces the Axios error via react-error-overlay (red 'Uncaught runtime errors' dev banner) instead of a graceful fallback UI (e.g. 'This tournament is not hosted by your parent Division — you cannot participate here.'). Consider catching the 403 in the tournament loader and rendering an explicit access-denied card. Non-blocking for this sprint.

action_items: (low priority) Wrap 403 tournament access in a friendly access-denied UI card instead of relying on the dev error-overlay. Users on staging/prod without the dev overlay would see a blank finance console.
critical_code_review_comments: reimbursement_claims.py submit_claim (line ~346-390): host_body_id-driven routing is clean and correctly handles all three cases (MPCA-owned/District blocked; DIV-owned/wrong-parent blocked; DIV-owned/right-parent routed to host Division). Error messages are user-facing quality.

reimbursement_claims.py consolidate_district_claims (line ~665-670): the host_body_id != division_body_id guard executes BEFORE the Division-body-type check — good order because the host guard is the primary contract.

tournaments.py get_tournament (line ~200-210): District read guard raises 403 immediately when host_body_id != parent_code. Correct — no fall-through to acceptance/participants for Districts. Note: if the tournament is DIV-BPL-hosted but the District is participating via acceptance table (edge case cross-division invite), current code will 403; per M39z.e spec that's the intended contract.

list_claims (line ~245-251): the reviewer-scope branch is a no-op pass — it deliberately skips adding q.update(body_scope(scope)) so the route_to_body_id filter below covers scoping. Slightly non-obvious; a comment would help but logic is sound.
TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx still 1435 lines (grown from 1420 last sprint) — code-review debt continues; ClaimsPanel should be split into its own file. Not blocking.

TournamentFinanceConsole.jsx submitClaim() line 1105 target-label derivation uses persona.parent_body_code hard-coded for district — this is a *label only*, backend still authoritatively routes via tournament.host_body_id. Just cosmetic. Consider deriving from `tournament.host_body_id` instead for future-proofing.

No regression tests added for legacy claims (created before M39z.e) whose route_to_body_id is stale — they still work because the guards only fire at submit/consolidate time. Backwards-compat verified through existing master TRC-2026-27-0004.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 tests, some skip in bulk-run due to state carry-over but all pass in isolation)
success_rate.frontend: 100% — all four persona×tournament copy/panel-visibility scenarios verified
